accepted_facts: GSE68183 contains three non-ulcerated diabetic foot-skin and three healthy non-diabetic foot-skin samples.
GSE80178 contains six DFU samples plus the same three DFS and three NFS raw control objects.
All six reused accession pairs have exact decompressed-CEL identity and concordant sample titles and group semantics.
Eighteen accession rows collapse to twelve conservative analytic independence units.
GSE68183 is a control-source and comparator-context dataset, not an independent DFU validation cohort for GSE80178.
locked_rules: Count each exact shared raw object once.
Do not relabel GSE68183 intact foot skin as DFU tissue.
Retain DFS and NFS as explicit comparator strata.
Use pooled foot skin only under a declared compatible-contrast or sensitivity specification.
Do not invent real participant identifiers.
remaining_boundaries: Real participant identifiers are not public.
Full M01 still requires role audit and interface integration for the remaining candidate datasets.
M02 must validate participant/sample assumptions before modeling.
reopen_authority: AUTHOR plus documented primary-source contradiction or M02 interface failure
